# clickup_list_view (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `columns` (Attributes) Column configuration for the view. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--columns))
- `divide` (Attributes) Divide configuration for the view. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--divide))
- `filters` (Attributes) Filter configuration for the view. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `grouping` (Attributes) Grouping configuration for the view. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grouping))
- `list_id` (String) ClickUp list_id path parameter required to create this list_view.
- `name` (String) The name of the view.
- `settings` (Attributes) View-specific settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))
- `sorting` (Attributes) Sorting configuration for the view. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sorting))
- `team_sidebar` (Attributes) Team sidebar configuration for the view. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--team_sidebar))
- `type` (String) The type of view. Options include: `list`, `board`, `calendar`, `table`, `timeline`, `workload`, `activity`, `map`, `conversation`, or `gantt`.

### Optional

- `parent` (Attributes) The parent location of the view in the ClickUp hierarchy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--parent))
- `view_id` (String) The ClickUp-generated view id.

<a id="nestedatt--columns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `columns`

Required:

- `fields` (Attributes List) Each element is an object describing a column. Use `jsonencode()` if building from HCL. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--columns--fields))

<a id="nestedatt--columns--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `columns.fields`

Required:

- `field` (String) The field name to show in the column.

Optional:

- `display` (String) The display value of the column.
- `hidden` (Boolean) Whether the column is hidden.
- `idx` (Number) The column order index.
- `name` (String) The display name of the column.
- `width` (Number) The column width in pixels.



<a id="nestedatt--divide"></a>
### Nested Schema for `divide`

Required:

- `collapsed` (List of String)

Optional:

- `dir` (Number) Divide direction. Use `1` or `-1`.
- `field` (String) The field used to divide tasks.


<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `fields` (Attributes List) Each element is a filter object. The `values` attribute should be a JSON-encoded string. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters--fields))
- `op` (String) The logical operator for combining filters. Use `AND` or `OR`.
- `search` (String) Free-text search term.
- `show_closed` (Boolean) Whether to include closed tasks in the view.

<a id="nestedatt--filters--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters.fields`

Required:

- `field` (String) The field to filter by.

Optional:

- `determinor` (String) The filter determinor.
- `idx` (Number) The filter index.
- `op` (String) The filter operator, such as `EQ` or `ANY`.
- `values` (String) The filter value(s). Use `jsonencode()` to encode strings, arrays, or objects.



<a id="nestedatt--grouping"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grouping`

Required:

- `collapsed` (List of String)
- `dir` (Number) Group sort direction. Use `1` or `-1`.
- `field` (String) The field to group by, such as `status`, `priority`, `assignee`, `tag`, or `dueDate`.
- `ignore` (Boolean) Whether to ignore grouping.


<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Required:

- `me_checklists` (Boolean) Show tasks with checklists assigned to me.
- `me_comments` (Boolean) Show tasks with comments assigned to me.
- `me_subtasks` (Boolean) Show subtasks assigned to me.
- `show_assignees` (Boolean) Whether to show assignees.
- `show_closed_subtasks` (Boolean) Whether to show closed subtasks.
- `show_images` (Boolean) Whether to show images.
- `show_subtask_parent_names` (Boolean) Whether to show subtask parent names.
- `show_subtasks` (Number) How to show subtasks. Use `1`, `2`, or `3`.
- `show_task_locations` (Boolean) Whether to show task locations.

Optional:

- `collapse_empty_columns` (String) Whether to collapse empty columns. May be `null`.


<a id="nestedatt--sorting"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sorting`

Required:

- `fields` (Attributes List) Each element is a sort object. Use `jsonencode()` if building from HCL. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sorting--fields))

<a id="nestedatt--sorting--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sorting.fields`

Required:

- `field` (String) The field to sort by.

Optional:

- `dir` (Number) Sort direction. Use `1` or `-1`.
- `idx` (Number) The sort index.



<a id="nestedatt--team_sidebar"></a>
### Nested Schema for `team_sidebar`

Required:

- `assigned_comments` (Boolean) Show assigned comments in the team sidebar.
- `assignees` (List of String) Assignees included in the team sidebar.
- `unassigned_tasks` (Boolean) Show unassigned tasks in the team sidebar.


<a id="nestedatt--parent"></a>
### Nested Schema for `parent`

Required:

- `id` (String) The id of the parent (Workspace, Space, Folder, or List).
- `type` (Number) The hierarchy type. Workspace=7, Space=4, Folder=5, List=6.
